newsitem.title: USA: Wireless One names H. Schopfer CFO.
newsitem.headline: Wireless One names H. Schopfer CFO.

text.p: Wireless One Inc named Henry G. Schopfer III as executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective immediately.
Mr. Schopfer was previously vice president and chief financial officer of Daniel Industries Inc, a Houston, Texas-based manufacturer of oil field related products.
Schopfer replaces Robert Gary, who resigned last April to join CompUSA Inc.
Wireless One develops, owns and operates wireless cable television systems, primarily in rural markets in the Southeastern United States.
